doc.title: Al Vollmer interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, June 8, 2017

chapter: Jazz's place and the band's future
title: What would make him stop
summary: Energy and opposition would stop him; he is somewhat jaded but did it for himself too.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: What would cause you to stop doing this?

Well, and opposition. In other words when I’m succeeding, and I’m getting them jobs and we’re going this-where and we’ve got this to do and that to do, that energizes me. But I’m getting a little bit jaded now, a little bit feeling that well I don’t need to be the glue anymore. But I must say I mean I haven’t done it totally for their sake. I’ve done it because I wanted to be part of it.
